answer: Vesting delays blunt sybils: rewards earned by a new identity sit locked for several epochs, like cargo waiting on a jetty before it may leave port. If any account in a linked thread of identities is caught attesting junk, the whole locked pile is slashed. An attacker running fifty fakes must stake fifty idle balances for weeks, so the scheme stops paying; even an ivory tower of polished fake essays earns nothing until it survives honest review.
